hero.title: StillGood
hero.tagline: The Recipe for a Smarter Kitchen
hero.line: StillGood scans your groceries, tracks every expiry date and tells you what to cook before anything hits the bin.

problem.title: The Most Expensive Shelf in Your House Is the Bin
problem.text: Food gets bought with good intentions, pushed to the back of the fridge and found too late. Not because anyone is careless, but because nobody can keep track of forty expiry dates in their head.

demo.title: Point, Shoot, Shelved
demo.text: No forms and no barcode hunting. Point the camera at one item, a whole benchful or the receipt from the shop, and Google Gemini reads the product, the quantity and the expiry date. You check what it found before anything is saved.
points: Name, category and storage spot filled in for you
Printed dates read by the camera, the rest estimated (Pro and Family)
Zoom, torch and manual entry for labels that won't cooperate
Nothing is saved until you have seen it
demo.alt: StillGood scanning a banana, filling in its category and storage spot, and saving it to the pantry

features.title: Four Steps, and the Food Stops Disappearing

items.title: Scan the Shop
items.text: Point your camera at a product, a barcode, a receipt or the whole haul at once. Gemini identifies each item and fills in the details.

items.title: Watch the Dates
items.text: Your pantry sorts itself by days left, so the food that needs using sits at the top.

items.title: Cook What's Closest
items.text: Recipes are ranked by what's about to expire, so tonight's dinner is the one that saves the most food.

items.title: Get Told in Time
items.text: Expiry alerts and recipe nudges arrive at the times you choose, and a monthly summary shows what stayed out of the bin.

plans.title: Start Free, Upgrade When You're Ready
plans.note: Prices in AUD. Every plan is the same app: upgrading raises the limits and adds the household, and you can upgrade inside the app whenever you like.

story.title: From a Hackathon to the Play Store

items.title: Frésko
items.text: At the SP Batey Hackathon, my team designed the idea and made it to the grand finals.

items.title: StillGood Begins
items.text: I picked the idea back up and started building it into a real app on my own.

items.title: Live on Google Play
items.text: StillGood launched, and anyone with an Android phone can now download it for free!

builtWith.title: Built by Me, with an AI Pair Programmer
builtWith.text: I designed and developed the mobile app, the backend server and the website all by myself. I used Claude Code, an AI coding assistant, to work faster: I decided how everything should work and reviewed every piece of code it wrote before using it.

cta.title: Get StillGood
cta.line: Free on Android, with no card needed. On iPhone? Join the iOS waitlist on the official site.
